The affix वतुप्‌ comes in the sense of 'that where of this is the measure of volume' after the words 1.यद् 2. तद् and 3. एतद् being in the Nominative 1st-Case of construction.

Terms: वतुप्‌

A finite verb followed by यत् or हि or तु retains its accent in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: Accent

In connection with यद् in all its forms, the verb retains its accent always.

Terms: Accent
